# Timed preset: 300 s of play time, golden goal on a tie (spec 02 §7.2).
config pause=0s                  # inactivity is tested in 13-lifecycle
start timed
wait 100s
sensor home_goal
expect score 0:1
expect playtime 100s
wait 199s
expect phase playing
wait 1s
expect winner away reason=time
expect last finished side=away

# Tie at the end: golden goal, the next goal wins.
start timed
sensor away_goal
sensor home_goal
wait 300s
expect phase playing
expect last golden_goal
expect score 1:1
wait 60s                      # the clock has run out; golden goal waits
expect phase playing
restart                       # survives a restart
expect phase playing
sensor away_goal
expect score 2:1
expect winner home reason=golden_goal

# Tie with time_tie=draw.
start win=10 by=1 limit=60s tie=draw
wait 60s
expect winner draw reason=time
expect score 0:0

# A sensor goal stamped after the end of the time does not count, even if the tick is late.
start win=10 by=1 limit=10s tie=draw
jump 15s                      # the clock moves on without a tick (busy table)
sensor home_goal at=-4s       # scored at 11 s: too late
expect winner draw reason=time
expect score 0:0

start win=10 by=1 limit=10s tie=draw
jump 15s
sensor home_goal at=-6s       # scored at 9 s: counts, then the time is up
expect score 0:1
wait 0s
expect winner away reason=time
expect games 5
